prerequisites.title: X account and Developer Console access
prerequisites.detail: Sign in at console.x.com, accept the Developer Agreement and Policy, and describe how you will use the API.

prerequisites.title: Prepaid API credits
prerequisites.detail: Credits are bought upfront; requests are blocked if the balance goes negative or a spending limit is reached.

steps.title: Create developer account and app
steps.detail: Sign in at console.x.com, accept the agreement, give a name, description and use case, and create the app.
steps.done_when: App exists in the Developer Console

steps.title: Save client ID and secret
steps.detail: Credentials are shown only once; save them immediately.
steps.done_when: Client ID and secret stored securely

steps.title: Add Composio callback URL to allowlist
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and add it exactly to the app's allowlist; production must use HTTPS.
steps.done_when: Callback URL saved in the app settings

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret.

steps.title: Buy credits and set a spend limit
steps.detail: Purchase credits in the Developer Console and set a per-cycle spending limit.

steps.title: Request approval for AI replies
steps.detail: Get X's approval before deploying AI-generated replies; the process is not documented in the dossier.

traps.title: Developers who requested Ads API access before July 2023
traps.detail: Developers who requested Ads API access before July 2023 may have a limit of 5 user OAuth tokens on their application.

traps.title: AI-generated replies need prior approval
traps.detail: Deploying AI-generated replies without approval is a violation, even if helpful. Violations can mean suspension or permanent bans.

traps.title: Credentials shown only once
traps.detail: Losing them requires regeneration, which invalidates the old ones.

traps.title: Callback URL must match exactly
traps.detail: Match the redirect URI exactly, including trailing slashes. Use http://127.0.0.1, not localhost, for local development.

traps.title: Do not create duplicate apps
traps.detail: Creating multiple apps for the same use case, including to bypass limits, is prohibited.

traps.title: Scraping and AI training are banned
traps.detail: Browser automation or scraping means a permanent ban; training AI models on X data is prohibited except for Grok.

traps.title: Composio domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: X's docs do not show redirect-domain verification, so no proxy is required. If you want to hide Composio's domain, proxy the callback through your own domain with a 302 redirect.

blockers.what_it_means: Credit balance is negative or the spending limit is reached.
blockers.what_to_do: Add credits or wait for the next billing cycle.

blockers.symptom: App suspended or API access revoked
blockers.what_to_do: Open a support ticket; one reported case took about 30 hours with escalation.

open_questions: How does X approve AI-generated replies, and how long does it take? Ask X developer support or check the developer guidelines.
Which OAuth 2.0 scopes need extra review, if any? The docs name none; test in the Developer Console or ask X support.
Does Composio plan a managed X app? Check the Composio managed-auth page.
